empresa.heroTitle: Transforming ideas into solid solutions since 1990
empresa.heroDesc: With over 30 years of experience, EQUINOX S.L. specializes in industrial boilermaking and process equipment manufacturing for the most demanding sectors, ensuring quality, precision, and reliability.
empresa.compromisoDesc1: At EQUINOX, we don't just manufacture equipment; we build trust. We understand that in sectors like pharmaceutical or food, an imperfect finish or porous weld can mean million-dollar production stops.
empresa.compromisoDesc2: We offer a comprehensive service: design and calculation according to international standards, manufacturing, installation, maintenance, and equipment legalization. We work with stainless steel, carbon steel, and special alloys.
compromisoList: Equipment design and calculation (ASME, EN-13445, TEMA, AD-Merkblätter)
Stainless steel, carbon steel, and special alloys (Hastelloy, Duplex)
Comprehensive service: manufacturing, installation, maintenance, and legalization
